scope: Reconcile current ACadRust advertised version matrix, skipped corpus tests, ACIS test evidence, and OpenCADStudio codec lineage with the existing DWG/DXF/3D peer plan.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research plus local plan inspection
sourceObservations: ACadRust README prose describes DXF/DWG R12 through R2018+, while its detailed table shows AC1009 DXF R/W and DWG unavailable; the adjacent note says AC1009 DWG fidelity is incomplete.
ACadRust README says drawing-dependent tests for files absent from the repository are #[ignore]d and must be selected with --ignored when the input is available.
The visible ACadRust roundtrip source fabricates marker-bearing SAB-like bytes for a transport/association test and also invokes its own DWG writer followed by its own reader.

OpenCADStudio advertises DWG/DXF R13 through R2018 and 3D/ACIS tessellation; ACadRust names it as an application using ACadRust as its core DWG/DXF engine. This is a correlated codec lineage, not independent parser evidence.
ACadRust's optional import feature names STL, COLLADA, OBJ, glTF/GLB, and FBX imports separately from its ACIS SAT/SAB modeling-data feature.
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing ACadRust release/version matrix, R12 effective-output and peer-test-evidence entries, synthetic ACIS controls, and OpenCADStudio lineage rows
DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md: existing parser/carrier/semantic/native-acceptance evidence gates and six external-only dispositions
method.evidenceRule: Mutable README claims, ignored fixture tests, synthetic marker payloads, and same-codec round trips are route-specific evidence only. They do not establish AC1009 DWG support, external corpus coverage, independent ACIS interpretation, or native solid semantics.

correctedPeerDisposition.reason: The current README's detailed table lists no AC1009 DWG support, despite broader prose; no exact peer artifact/input route was run.

peerExecutionReadinessRefinement: At the existing composed checkpoint, record exact artifact/source, toolchain/features, test command, passed/failed/ignored counts, and input hashes/provenance.
A default cargo test pass does not count ignored drawing-dependent tests as corpus coverage.
Record a missing/unavailable drawing route as NOT_RUN and continue; do not add peer runs to the per-slice loop.
